text: Meet Muni Alert. A clearer way to report municipal emergencies and public hazards.
Choose a category, add safe photos, and describe what happened. Use GPS or a manual pin, then confirm the incident location.
Photos and exact locations stay private. Public updates use reviewed summaries.
Municipal teams review reports, verify locations and record action taken. Citizens can follow status updates and resolution photos.
Group records by week or month, then filter and export. Counts describe reports, not confirmed casualties.
Start with the feature tour, or search the user manual. Clear instructions for citizens and municipal administrators.
Muni Alert. For immediate danger, call emergency services first.
